description: Discovers running Linux Docker containers and collects state, health, CPU, memory, network, block I/O and process metrics.
technicalNotes: Connects to system.hostname over SSH (ssh.user plus ssh.pass or ssh.cert, optional ssh.port) and runs the Docker CLI on the host. The SSH user must be in the docker group, or set docker.cmd to "sudo -n docker". Swarm task containers are keyed on <service>.<slot> so instances survive redeploys.
name: Linux_Docker_Containers
